unavailable_fields.nccl_wire_transfer_ms: No collector separates NCCL in-kernel waiting from wire transfer; nsys timelines cannot, and kernel duration sums are wait-inclusive by definition.
unavailable_fields.pcie_bytes_per_collective: Only device-wide NVML rate samples exist (native 20 ms driver windows, exact boundaries unavailable, taken outside the workload); per-collective PCIe bytes would require unavailable hardware byte counters, and logical payload is not traffic.
unavailable_fields.nvlink_bytes: nvmlDeviceGetNvLinkState returned NVML status 3 on both GPUs; no NVLink links or per-link counters are exposed.
unavailable_fields.hardware_utilization: Hardware counters require a successful collector-specific probe; topology and logical payload do not measure traffic.
unavailable_fields.execution_timeline.gpu_readiness_and_con: Clock alignment bounds are reported for matching CPU submissions only; GPU readiness and consumer completion may remain unknown.
unavailable_fields.communication_critical_path_ms: No collector measures the step's communication critical path; collective_calibration is a synthetic warmed reference experiment, not a performance lower bound or critical-path estimate.

rationale: Candidate 03c5e5abcdf4f4cf519e4e909e2b48a3d8e54414dd924a31dabd04f5f3878fbb (bundle trial-recovered-0f41339f0a-param-afbf38f4, declared route aligned_final_backward_barrier on call 5d7d6bb13691b02f533f62b0) is the only listed revision and its clean screening left concrete uncertainty: it lowered the frozen objective communication_kernel_sum_ms (max rank 74.675611 -> 64.149113 ms; rank 0 63.433, rank 1 64.149) while violating the step_ms <= 1.05x baseline constraint (144.138 > 138.660 ms), so parameter screening accepted nothing. The metric is wait-inclusive: parent discovery recorded identical per-rank collective sequences (13 allreduces: 12x 28,351,488 B + 1x 157,541,376 B, fp32, RING_LL kernel entries, SHM/direct/direct transport on 2 channels, peer access disabled) while rank 1 summed 200.615 ms of NCCL kernel time against rank 0's 58.898 ms in the same profiled step, so most kernel duration is arrival skew and in-kernel waiting rather than transfer. It is therefore unresolved whether the candidate's comm-sum drop is genuine transfer reduction or redistributed waiting that also serialized the step; the +12 ms step change must not be assumed to be algorithm cost. nsys (status available) is selected to attribute compute/communication overlap and per-collective sequencing on this exact candidate. execution_timeline is selected to corroborate the candidate-reported barrier route with actual synchronization events, CPU-to-CUDA submit associations, per-device intervals and passive gradient post-accumulate callbacks, since route labels are candidate telemetry and not independent native proof. binding_cost is applicable (an additive candidate exists, bundles do not replace the parent; effective binding direct, no functional replacements) and isolates whole-invocation binding overhead from candidate computation in clean AB/BA workers, ruling the wrapper in or out of the step regression. nccl_tuning is selected because kernel entry names alone do not identify the protocol: actual algorithm/protocol/channel decisions at the observed sizes and dtype determine whether a genuine transport-side reduction of the communication objective remains available rather than only wait rearrangement; it does not join payload sizes to operator groups or supply timing. torch already ran and supplied the objective field in evaluation.json; device_telemetry (device-wide readings with native windows, not per-collective bytes), collective_calibration (synthetic reference experiment), python_runtime (perturbing host profiling whose inclusive/self times are not clean scores), and candidate_diagnostics (route/coverage telemetry already present in evaluation.json) were not selected. No optimization action is prescribed by this plan; it only resolves the observed uncertainty for subsequent search decisions.
